properties.description: Built 2026-10-19 (branch feat/hypothesis-tests, hypothesis.rs, detect.rs). The record carries no time and the core takes no clock, so WHEN is reflow2's own write order: the first add_verification with `hypothesis_block` writes Verification.criteria_at_data, the lock — the date that write gave (last_run_at), the record's own test, alternative, α, H0, H1 and variance, and the deciding fields of each criterion node linked then: the α Constraint the record names (limit, statement), what the check VERIFIES (statement), the Decisions it is GOVERNED_BY (decision, chose). A later attachment keeps the first lock. Any criterion that differs is reported by name with both values, the attach date, and the ChangeEvents that CHANGED it (detected_at, epoch, whether dated after the data): on get_node's test_reading.criteria_changed and as the gap criteria_changed_after_data (severity 0.6, keyed per change set, acknowledgeable with the owner's reason). Nothing is refused and the test's truth does not move. Criteria linked after the lock are listed as criteria_unlocked. A change made outside the design, or before the lock, is invisible.
properties.name: A test's criteria are locked when its data are first attached, and a later change to α, the test or the hypothesis is reported with both values
